topic: Potential and Kinetic Energy and Newton's Laws
key_concepts: Kinetic energy is energy in motion
Potential energy is energy of position
Gravitational acceleration on Earth is 9.8 m/s²
Mass is the amount of matter in an object
Velocity describes speed in a particular direction
Height and mass affect gravitational potential energy
Kinetic energy depends on mass and velocity
A hanging mango has greater potential energy and little or no kinetic energy
Moving objects such as a rolling ball or a bicyclist have kinetic energy
Stored or elevated objects such as a drawn bow or a ball on a rack have potential energy
Newton's second law relates net force direction to acceleration direction
For every action force, there is an equal and opposite reaction force
